answer: Because the timing is recorded against the dawn challenge, the glacier audit can replay the ledge history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 47 submissions and hold each member open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 56 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
